english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that something is probable or has a better-than-even chance of happening.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

examples.english: We are likely to close this deal after talking it through.
examples.traditional: 我哋好有可能傾掂呢單生意。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hou2 jau5 ho2 nang4 keng1 dim6 ni1 daan1 saang1 ji3

examples.english: It is probable that this news is true.
examples.traditional: 呢個消息好有可能係真㗎。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 hou2 jau5 ho2 nang4 hai6 zan1 gaa3
